Contract CT-21e (listAdminPayOrders, getAdminPayOrder, listAdminPayAnomalies, listAdminPayReconDiffs); backend B2-15f / B2-15j merged; refs BR-PAY-06, BR-PAY-07. Pay order list with contract filters, paging, amounts bound to columns, dictionary names with raw-code fallback; detail with amounts, refunds and recent channel requests, no channel-side user id rendered; anomalies and R4 recon-diff lists (sign kept); three states; only the four GETs (and shell public reads) are sent, no write entry (refund, resolve, recon handling, export not in this part). Amounts shown through @couli/money, no client arithmetic. No frozen test changed. Rule tests written by an independent Claude (Codex unavailable until 2026-11-02; ledger tester claude-independent, approvals id 36); Claude spec-test review r1 pass (6 S2); red on the test machine (red/1). Implementation by Opus 5.5; test machine verify-fast/2 and browser/1 green, re-verified after merging the App.tsx routes of F1-08a. Adversarial money review by a fresh independent Claude r1 pass, no findings. Written by hand.
